item.title: The bollard has been knocked over and drivers cannot see the concrete stand it is on., 24th October
item.description:
This bollard was knocked down last year, probably because drivers couldn't see it properly. The lighting was non existent in the dark. It was replaced with the same box style and the lighting was still terrible. It has been knocked down again. Could you consider improving the lighting that lights the box or replace the style with the bright orange reflective ones please? The concrete stand is a danger being unlit as vehicles travel over the bridge.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Erith Road, Barnehurst, Greater London
